priorityList: Ensure Arcane Intellect is active and pre-cast Blizzard or Glacial Spike before combat begins.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities alongside Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost.
Cast Blizzard immediately whenever the Freezing Rain buff is active.
Use Flurry when Brain Freeze is active, unless Thermal Void is currently extending your Icy Veins.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate procs and reduce Blizzard's cooldown.
Cast Glacial Spike as soon as you reach 5 Icicles.
Cast Blizzard as a priority when facing 5 or more enemies, or if Frozen Orb is on a long cooldown.
Use Ice Lance if you have Fingers of Frost procs.
Use Ice Lance if the target has 10 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff from Splinterstorm.
Use Flurry charges to apply Winter's Chill if no other high-priority procs are available.
Cast Ray of Frost as long as the Frostfire Empowerment buff is not active.
During movement, prioritize Blizzard (if Freezing Rain is active), Ice Nova, or Cone of Cold.
Use Frostbolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and Brain Freeze procs.
